candidates.title: Daily sales by product (till system)
candidates.why_relevant: Only internal source of daily units and revenue per product code; catalog grain is daily, temporal coverage starts 2022-01-01 with no end date, refreshed daily (last 2026-10-14). Covers both windows on paper. Approx 310000 rows per catalog.
candidates.found_via: search 'daily sales ice cream by product' and 'gelato sales daily export'; get_catalog_entry; wiki backlink till_migration_2024
suspected_issues: Product codes changed from 2024-04-01; codes ending in 'L' replaced (wiki product_codes_2024, last edited 2024-04-02)
No mapping table between old and new codes exists (wiki product_codes_2024)
Till system replaced 2024-02-05 to 2024-03-10: no rows for those days, must be treated as missing not zero (wiki till_migration_2024, last edited 2024-03-12)
Zero-sales days may be absent rather than zero; not documented in catalog
Till-day cut-off timezone and refund/void handling not documented in catalog
Classification confidential; access via request to Retail Operations

candidates.title: Product list (current codes)
candidates.why_relevant: Product master with names and categories (approx 64 rows); the only internal product reference, and the name field is the only available bridge for matching old codes to new ones.
candidates.found_via: search 'product code mapping 2024 change'; get_catalog_entry; wiki backlink product_codes_2024
suspected_issues: Lists only current codes, so pre-2024 codes are absent (catalog description; wiki product_codes_2024)
Last refreshed 2025-03-31 despite refresh 'on change'
Product names not unique per wiki, so name matching is unreliable
Does not satisfy N2 on its own; no mapping table exists

candidates.title: Shop calendar (opening days, closures, local events)
candidates.why_relevant: Only internal record of daily is_open status and event_name, which is what N5 asks for; covers 2022 onward per catalog (approx 1500 rows).
candidates.found_via: search 'temperature daily shop location' and 'shop opening hours closed days log'; get_catalog_entry
suspected_issues: Refreshed weekly; no wiki page documents it, so closure history and opening-hour changes are not confirmed
event_name is free text with no publisher, dates or geography stated
Catalog does not say how many event_name values are populated
Closed days must not be read as zero demand

candidates.title: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (reanalysis)
candidates.why_relevant: Register source for daily max temperature; agreement not required (open data), approved for prototyping and production. Covers 2023-06-01 to 2026-03-31 at daily grain if requested.
suspected_issues: Register default_query coordinates (38.72, -9.14) are Lisbon, not Italy; the shop town must be chosen and coordinates set as an assumption in decisions.md
Register default timezone is UTC; daily max must be requested in Europe/Rome or the day boundary must be justified
Reanalysis is modelled, not station observations; disclose to owner
Shop town not named in any source

candidates.title: Nager.Date public holidays API
candidates.why_relevant: Register source for Italian public holidays by year (country IT, years 2023 to 2026 needed); open-data, approved for prototyping and production.
suspected_issues: Regional and local (patron-saint) holidays for the shop town are not expected from a national API; needs a separate source or is flagged as missing
Not yet profiled; whether IT list matches the official national list is unverified

searches_run: daily sales ice cream by product
shop opening hours closed days log
SKU crosswalk legacy codes old new product
local events calendar town municipality shop
unmet_needs: N2: No old-to-new product code mapping exists internally (wiki product_codes_2024 says none; sales.products has current codes only). Needs a manual crosswalk built from product names with Retail Operations input, or the owner's confirmation of which products can be compared. Product-level comparison across 2024-04-01 may have to be restricted to products whose names are unique.

N5: No register source for local events; the internal shop calendar is the only event record and its coverage is unverified. A municipal or regional tourism events calendar for the chosen town must be supplied as a link by the human, with dated entries.
N4 (regional part): No register source covers regional or patron-saint holidays for the shop's town. Needs a human-supplied Italian regional holiday list once the town is chosen.
Shop town: no source names the city. Location choice is an assumption that must be confirmed by the owner before the Open-Meteo call.
